title: Lean lab: abort a real lean, then take over a leaning pawn (DPC 0.9.176-dev6)
intro: Forcing a lean doesn't work (only the pawn's AI starts one), but in lean-lab-2 the second Archer pawn was leaning the whole time. This test works on whichever pawn is leaning: the pawn row on screen shows IN INTERACTION. SAVE FIRST. Press End to start.

steps.text: 1/6 Tavern, playing the Arisen, SAVE FIRST. Wait until the pawn row on screen shows IN INTERACTION for one pawn (in lean-lab-2 the second Archer pawn was already leaning). Then End.
2/6 (automatic) Asking the leaning pawn to stop the game's way (abort), without you playing it. Watch it.
3/6 Wait until a pawn shows IN INTERACTION again (leaning), then End.
4/6 (automatic) Taking control of the leaning pawn: DPC should make it stand up first, then hand it to you.
5/6 Walk around as that pawn: can it move? End.
6/6 Back to the Arisen. Tell Claude: did it stand up in step 2, and could you move it in step 5? End.

probes.who: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.state.active and ('playing '..tostring(D.state.pawn_name)) or 'Arisen') or ''
probes.pawns: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local pm=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.PawnManager'); local l=pm and pm:call('get_PawnCharacterList'); if not (D and l) then return '' end; local t={}; for i=0,l:call('get_Count')-1 do local c=l:call('get_Item',i); local n='?'; pcall(function() n=tostring(c:call('get_ActionManager'):get_field('Fsm'):call('getCurrentNodeName(System.UInt32)',0)) end); t[#t+1]=i..':'..(D.R.busy_interact(c) and 'IN INTERACTION ' or '')..n end; return table.concat(t,' / ')
probes.spots: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.R.lean_spots) or ''
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
